name: CaseVarFallbackChain
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "var-fallback-chain" (custom-properties). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: color: var(--cf-missing, var(--cf-color-secondary, #333)) COMPUTED-ENRICHED (extract/computed): unlabeled styled channels minted from computed-style capture of @ds-contracts/conformance@0.1.0 in headless Chromium 149.0.7827.55; overflow channels in the sibling extension file.
